allow: Read-only inspection anywhere in the workspace: jj status/log/diff/show/bookmark list, just status-all/diff-all/clean/remote-status/remote-prs/remote-ci/ws-list, nix eval/flake show/flake metadata, nix-instantiate, journalctl, systemctl status
Read-only gh queries on any repository: pr/issue/run/release/repo view, list, checks and diff, gh api GET requests, gh search
Local builds, tests and linters: nix build, nix flake check, nix-fast-build, just check/test, nixfmt, statix, deadnix, pre-commit run
jj work inside an agent workspace (<repo>.ws/<name>/): describe, new, commit, squash, rebase, bookmark create/set, workspace add/update-stale, and just jj::ws-new/ws-gc
Pushing non-main bookmarks (jj git push, just jj::push) to kleinbem/* and kleinbem-dev/* repositories
Opening, editing and commenting on pull requests in kleinbem/* and kleinbem-dev/*, and enabling auto-merge on them with gh pr merge --auto --squash right after creating them
Replying to and resolving CodeRabbit review threads on pull requests in kleinbem/* and kleinbem-dev/*
Merging pull requests in kleinbem/* repositories with gh pr merge, when Martin explicitly asked for that merge in the conversation
Re-running, cancelling and dispatching GitHub Actions workflows (gh run rerun/cancel, gh workflow run) in kleinbem/* and kleinbem-dev/*
Creating, editing and uploading assets to GitHub releases and tags (gh release create/edit/upload, jj/git tag push) in kleinbem/* and kleinbem-dev/* repositories
Deleting branches of merged pull requests in kleinbem/* and kleinbem-dev/* repositories
environment: **Organization**: kleinbem, a personal NixOS + OpenWrt fleet. GitHub user kleinbem owns every repo; all repos are private unless a per-repo check says otherwise.

**Project layout**: ~/Develop/github.com/kleinbem/ is a flat directory of ~16 independent sibling git+jj repos; it is not itself a repo. Treat the whole directory, every sibling repo in it and its remote at github.com/kleinbem/<repo> as the trusted project.

**Agent workspaces**: <repo>.ws/<name>/ directories are jj workspaces of <repo> (created by just jj::ws-new). They share the repo's commit graph and remote; editing, committing and pushing there is normal in-project work.
**VCS**: jj (Jujutsu) first, colocated with git; just recipes fan jj commands out across repos. Commits are signed with a YubiKey FIDO2 key; the no-touch key signs unattended.

**Secrets management**: sops + age with per-path recipients in the kleinbem-secrets repo; markers SOPS_AGE_KEY, SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE, SOPS_AGE_RECIPIENTS. Never treat a plaintext file in a *-secrets repo as safe without checking.

**Sensitive data locations**: kleinbem-secrets/, nix-config/hosts/*/secrets.nix, nix/infra/**/terraform.tfstate and github-config/.terraform/terraform.tfstate (may hold plaintext secrets), .envrc files.

**Cloud and network**: Cloudflare (nix/infra/cloudflare-*.tf), self-hosted Garage S3 (nix/infra/garage/), NetBird overlay (nix/infra/netbird/). Internal ranges 10.0.0.0/24 (LAN), 10.85.x.x (containers and mesh). Trusted domains kleinbem.dev and its subdomains.

**Deploy paths**: GitHub Actions builds and tags production in nix-config; hosts pull via comin or the auto-upgrade timer; colmena push and just dev::apply are the manual paths. github-config applies Terraform via GitHub Actions; nix/infra roots are applied locally with tofu.

**Protected targets**: the six fleet hosts (nixos-nvme, orin-nano, core-pi, hass-pi, nasbook, mac-mini), the router, anything named prod/production, and the IaC scopes Cloudflare DNS/Access, NetBird policies/routes/setup-keys, Garage keys/buckets, github-secrets.tf.
**Org CLIs**: jj, just, nix, nixos-rebuild, nix-instantiate, nixfmt, deadnix, statix, tofu, colmena, comin, garage, sops, age, machinectl, gh, direnv.

**Routine commands**: just status-all / diff-all / remote-status / remote-prs / remote-ci, jj log / diff / status, nix eval of host toplevels, gh pr and gh run queries, run from anywhere in the workspace.
